title: Grid-fee weekday rules are shifted a day: Mon-Fri skips Friday, Sat-Sun bills Friday and Saturday, Sunday never matches
claim: grid_fee.FeeRule.applies tests when.isoweekday() (Mon=1..Sun=7) against day sets parse_day_range builds in datetime.weekday() numbering (Mon=0..Sun=6), so over one week 192 of 672 quarter steps carry the wrong fee for the spec '= 0.05, Mon-Fri 06:00-22:00 = 0.25, Sat-Sun = 0.10, Nov-Mar 22:00-06:00 = 0.02' (all of Friday and all of Sunday).
mechanism: grid_fee.py:104 _DAYS maps mon->0; :162 applies() uses isoweekday(). Every weekday rule is evaluated one day late; the fee vector (coordinator._fee_series -> the plan's prices), current_fee (the ledger's grid_fee line and the savings' spot+fee) all read it.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: up to three seats share the box; a count, contention-immune

metric_definition: fee_mismatch_steps = quarter steps of the week 2026-01-12..18 (Europe/Stockholm) where fee_vector differs from the rule text's calendar meaning
phenomenon_property: A weekday token in a fee rule applies on the calendar day it names, in the same numbering the parser and the evaluator share.

null_control.value: grid_fee_mode=entity 0/672, none 0/672; rules mode mismatches only on Fri (96) and Sun (96)
null_control.note: month and hour windows of the same rules agree on every step
